entities.summary: Robert Joseph Kurtz, C.R., is an American-born Roman Catholic bishop. Kurtz, who was ordained as a Catholic priest in 1967, and served as the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Hamilton in Bermuda since his appointment on June 1, 1995, until his retirement on June 13, 2015.
